jobs.occupation: Carrier for night distribution at dao
jobs.description:
Carrier for night distribution, enjoy freedom and fast-paced work and become one of the starts of the night

The faster you work, the more you earn. Does that sound right up your alley? 

If you enjoy freedom with responsibility as well as working in the quiet of the night while others sleep, we would love to have you on board.

At dao, you will get:

• 
A flexible night job with around 32 hours per week

• 
Good training from day one and a supportive community

• 
Piecework pay as you deliver newspapers, letters, magazines and parcels by bike, scooter or car.

• 
Salary and conditions in accordance with the agreement with the workers union 3F

We deliver every night and all year

As a Danish delivery company, dao brings newspapers, letters, magazines, and parcels to people all over the country 365 days a year.

Even though you will be working on your own, you will never feel alone. Because your manager and the rest of your team is there for you.

Deliver at night while others sleep

Before you start, you will receive training to feel confident in your role. You will also by supported by an experienced colleague, and your manager will check in with you to make sure you are settling in well.

During your shift you will:

• 
Pack your bike, scooter or car with newspapers, letters, parcels and magazines. 

• 
Follow your route and deliver to doors and mailboxes

• 
Keep a good pace and meet deadlines

Not a resident? Not a problem!

If you do not live in Denmark, we will help you get settled. Because we know moving to a new country is not easy. During the interview we will tell you much more.

You enjoy working at night in all kinds of weather, and you:

• 
Are steady, responsible, and deliver with care and accuracy

• 
Can speak either English and/or Danish 

Ready to become our newest night owl?
Please aplly thorugh the following link: https://dao.career.emply.com/en/ad/carrier-for-night-distribution-at-dao/ihba5r

Comfortable taking ownership of your own deliverables and deadlines

Professional working proficiency in English

A permanent, full-time position in an established company

• 
Real influence on your own working methods, tools and technical choices

jobs.occupation: International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER
jobs.description:
International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• 
Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

• 
Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

• 
Quality assurance and photographic documentation

• 
Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

• 
Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

• 
Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

• 
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

• 
Registering and managing additional works and variations

• 
Participating in construction and project meetings

• 
Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

About You

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

The ability to communicate in English is important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but Danish does not need to be your native language.

What We Offer

At DK TØMRER, you will become part of a growing company with short decision-making processes and the opportunity to take on significant responsibility.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position involving a variety of construction projects

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
An international workplace that welcomes different nationalities and backgrounds

• 
The opportunity to gain valuable experience in Danish construction management

• 
Close cooperation with company management and our construction organisation

• 
Salary based on qualifications and experience

Work location: Copenhagen and Zealand
Company: DK TØMRER
Starting date: As soon as possible

If you are interested in the position, please send your CV and a short application to pm@dk-tomrer.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

• 
Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

• 
Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

• 
Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

• 
Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

• 
Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

• 
Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

• 
Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

• 
Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

• 
Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

• 
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

• 
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• 
A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

• 
Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

• 
Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

• 
Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

• 
Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

• 
Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

• 
A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

• 
Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Gråbrødretorv 9, st.tv., 1154 København K
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Steam

Steam is a unique Chinese restaurant in the heart of Copenhagen. We share the flavours we love through handmade food, regional Chinese dishes, and fermentation—from comforting brunch favourites to warming copper-pot rice noodles and dishes made for sharing.

Our hospitality is personal, welcoming, and relaxed. We care about good food and the small details that make guests feel at home.

We are looking for a hands-on Restaurant Manager to lead our front-of-house team, take ownership of daily operations, and help Steam grow.

The Role

You will lead from the floor, work closely with the kitchen team, and keep service running smoothly. From supporting colleagues during busy shifts to organising schedules and special events, you will combine warm hospitality with confident, practical leadership.

We are looking for someone who notices what needs doing, takes initiative, and follows through.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Service and guest experience: Lead daily service, manage reservations and table flow, and handle guest enquiries, special requests, and feedback with care.

• 
Team leadership and scheduling: Train and motivate the FOH team, give constructive feedback, prepare schedules within agreed staffing budgets, and oversee shift coverage and recorded hours.

• 
Menu knowledge and kitchen coordination: Ensure the team can confidently explain our food, drinks, and allergens, and maintain clear communication with the kitchen throughout service.

• 
Operations and business awareness: Maintain opening, closing, and cleanliness standards; oversee stock, ordering, and cash reconciliation; and identify ways to reduce waste and improve sales and efficiency.

• 
Events and collaborations: Help plan and deliver pop-ups, festivals, private bookings, and special events.

• 
Social media: Capture everyday moments, food, and events for Steam’s social channels.

About You

You enjoy taking responsibility, making decisions independently, and helping the team do its best work. You bring:

• 
At least 3 years of hospitality experience, ideally with supervisory or team leadership experience.

• 
Strong organisational skills, a calm approach during busy service, and confidence in solving problems and giving and receiving feedback.

• 
A warm, attentive approach to guests and a supportive attitude towards colleagues.

• 
An interest in Chinese food and a willingness to learn about our ingredients, techniques, and stories.

• 
Clear communication skills in English; Danish, Chinese, or Japanese are a plus.

• 
Availability to work evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

• 
A competitive salary based on experience and responsibilities.

• 
Real responsibility and room to shape daily operations.

• 
A supportive international team with a passion for food and hospitality.

• 
Opportunities to take part in food events, pop-ups, and creative collaborations.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short introduction about yourself and why you would like to join Steam to steam@steamfusion.dk, with “Steam Restaurant Manager” in the subject line.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.occupation: Bliv en del af vores tømrerteam / Join Our Carpentry Team
jobs.description:
SEE ENGLISH VERSION BELOW

Viking Gulvservice er en veletableret virksomhed beliggende i Københavns området, som gennem årene har leveret professionelle malerydelser til en bred vifte af kundetyper. Udover gulvarbejde tilbyder vi også tømrer- og malerarbejde.

Vi søger netop nu 1-2 erfarne kollegaer til vores tømrerteam, som kan være med til at løse virksomhedens opgaveportefølje.

Har du erfaring som tømrer og er du passioneret omkring dit arbejde, så kan vi tilbyde dig en attraktiv arbejdsplads med højt humør!

 

Om jobbet:

Hos Viking Gulvservice kommer du til at arbejde med række forskellige tømreropgave, bl.a. opbygning af gulvkonstruktioner, montering af gipsplader, opbygning af lettere trækonstruktioner m.m.

Du vil blive tilknyttet en kollega, så I altid er to om opgaverne, ved små opgaver må man forvente at arbejde selvstændigt. Som makkerpar får I stillet en firmabil til rådighed med de nødvendige maskiner og værktøj.

Vi forventer, at du:

1.       Har minimum 1 års erfaring indenfor tømrerfaget

2.       Har kørekort B

3.       Er pligtopfyldende og letforståelig på engelsk eller dansk

4.       Afslutter en opgave ryddelig og kvalitetsbevidst

Vi tilbyder:

1.       Attraktiv løn

2.       Arbejdstid i tidsrummet 07:00-15:00

3.       Kollegaer du kan sparrer med

4.       Spændende og alsidige opgave

 

Lyder stillingen interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail gm@vikinggulvservice.dk

Vi ser frem til din ansøgning og cv.

Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

ENGLISH:

Viking Gulvservice is a well-established company located in Ballerup. Over the years, we have provided professional painting services to a wide range of customers. In addition to flooring services, we also offer painting and carpentry services.

We are currently looking for 1–2 experienced colleagues to join our carpentry team and help us handle our growing portfolio of projects.

If you have experience as a carpenter and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a positive and friendly atmosphere.

 

About the job

At Viking Gulvservice, you will work on a variety of carpentry tasks, including building floor structures, installing plasterboard/drywall, constructing light timber structures, and other related carpentry work.

You will normally work together with a colleague, so there will usually be two of you assigned to each project. For smaller jobs, however, you should be comfortable working independently.

As a team, you will have access to a company vehicle equipped with the necessary machinery and tools.

We expect you to:

1.       Have at least 1 year of experience working as a carpenter

2.       Hold a valid Category B driving licence

3.       Be reliable, responsible and able to communicate in English or Danish

4.       Take pride in completing your work to a high standard and leaving the work area clean and tidy

We offer:

1.       Attractive salary

2.       Working hours between 07:00 and 15:00

3.       Supportive and experienced colleagues you can exchange knowledge with

4.       Exciting and varied carpentry projects

 

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions?

You are very welcome to contact us by email at gm@vikinggulvservice.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities

• Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
• Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
• Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
• Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
• Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
• Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
• Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
• Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
• Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
• Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
• Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
• Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.
Your professional background

• You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
• You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
• You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
• Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
• You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
• You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
• Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
• You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
• You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.
Personal qualities

• You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
• You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
• You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
• You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
• You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.
We offer

• A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
• A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
• The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
• Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
• An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
• Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.

Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

jobs.occupation: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
jobs.description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

• 
Strong research and publication record;

• 
Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

• 
Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

• 
Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

• 
Research plan.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.
